title: THE FOX WIFE
sub: three masks, and the fox gets the better lines

lines.text: THE FARMER: I found her at the gate in the rain, and I did not ask.
lines.speaker: THE FARMER

lines.text: THE WIFE: You did not ask. That was the whole of the bargain.
lines.speaker: THE WIFE

lines.text: THE WIFE: I will keep your house. I will not keep your questions.
lines.speaker: THE WIFE

lines.text: THE FOX — and her shadow on the paper wall has four tails in it.
lines.speaker: THE FOX

lines.text: THE FARMER: The rice came in twice. The well never went dry.
lines.speaker: THE FARMER

lines.text: THE WIFE: A son. And he has your hands.
lines.speaker: THE WIFE

lines.text: THE FARMER: And your eyes, which are not a farmer’s eyes.
lines.speaker: THE FARMER

lines.text: THE FOX — the child sleeps, and she sings something nobody in that village knows.
lines.speaker: THE FOX

lines.text: THE FARMER: The dog will not come in the house any more.
lines.speaker: THE FARMER

lines.text: THE WIFE: Dogs are stupid. Put it outside.
lines.speaker: THE WIFE

lines.text: THE FARMER: There is a bowl of still water by the door, wife. Look in it.
lines.speaker: THE FARMER

lines.text: THE FOX — she looks, and the water is honest.
lines.speaker: THE FOX

lines.text: THE WIFE: You asked. That was the whole of the bargain.
lines.speaker: THE WIFE

lines.text: THE FARMER: Nine years. I could have gone on not asking.
lines.speaker: THE FARMER

lines.text: THE FOX — she goes out of the door on four feet, and does not look back.
lines.speaker: THE FOX

lines.text: THE FARMER: There is a wood on the mountain where they say the foxes are.
lines.speaker: THE FARMER

lines.text: THE FARMER: It is nine miles and I am not a young man. Come out.
lines.speaker: THE FARMER

lines.text: THE FOX — something keeps pace with him in the trees and does not come out.
lines.speaker: THE FOX

lines.text: THE WIFE, WHO IS NOT HERE: Tell him his mother kept a farmer’s house for nine years.
lines.speaker: THE WIFE

lines.text: THE WIFE, WHO IS NOT HERE: That is a true thing, and he may have it.
lines.speaker: THE WIFE

lines.text: THE FARMER — and the trees are only trees, and he is a man standing in a wood.
lines.speaker: THE FARMER

lines.text: THE FARMER, ALONE: I did not ask. For nine years, I did not ask.
lines.speaker: THE FARMER

caughtBody: The performance came apart, the house stopped believing it, and in a bowl of still water on a stage a hundred people saw a fox looking back.

note.title: YOU PLAYED THE FOX
note.body: A house of a hundred people, and they went home talking about the third scene. The old actor will have you back.

greatNote.title: FORTY YEARS AND HE HAS SEEN IT TWICE
greatNote.body: You did not act frightened when the water came out. You went still, the way a thing goes still.

caughtNote.title: SEEN, ON A STAGE
caughtNote.body: Too many wrong faces and the illusion came apart in front of a hundred people. Nobody in that house believed what they saw, which is the only reason you walked out of it. One rule: the face the chorus asks for, every time.

thinNote.title: THEY WERE POLITE
thinNote.body: Nobody coughed on the way out, which is the worst thing an audience can do to you.

foxMissCall: THE WRONG FACE, ON HER LINE
warnCall: SOMEBODY IN THE FRONT ROW IS STARING
